name: Princess bedroom and dressing furniture
prompt:
Create ONE detailed modular FURNITURE REFERENCE SHEET, title INT-SUITE-FURN-001 — PRINCESS SUITE FURNITURE. Exactly FOUR separate spacious cells, one named furniture object per cell, light ivory studio background. Use ONLY supplied GEN-24 to match ivory and rose marble, gold lotus/rose/star details, indigo and blush insets. These are missing furniture types, not a new architectural style. Human proportions. No whole room, scenery, people, floating objects or unlabeled extras. Each cell has one LARGE three-quarter illustration plus small FRONT, SIDE, REAR and underside/contact diagram of the EXACT same object. Reveal simple construction/back thickness. Dimensions W,D,H are PROPOSED, not recovered. Keep fine carving crisp but do not thicken gold trim into bulky columns. Full component ID and name beside each cell. Isolate frame/base from textile, mirror and other existing accessories. No furniture merged into a wall. Footer: Source-compatible proposed furniture; hinges, views and mesh separation require modeling review.

INT-SUITE-FURN-001-S01 — Canopy bed frame. W,D,H [2.2, 2.7, 2.8] m proposed. ONE open four-post bed FRAME only. Exactly four slender ivory carved posts, rose lower rails, gilded lotus feet, pointed indigo/gold headboard with rose shell crest, open canopy rim. Two planar side rails join headboard and footboard, visible bed-slat support at mattress seat. No mattress, curtains, flowers, bedside furniture or bedding; those are reusable dressing inserts. Show real empty space within canopy and under frame.

INT-SUITE-FURN-001-S02 — Reversible bedside cabinet. W,D,H [0.65, 0.45, 0.75] m proposed. ONE bedside cabinet, not a pair: rose-veined ivory marble top, shallow drawer, two-door lower storage, gilded fine floral apron, four short legs. Display two doors closed in main view and small OPEN state inset showing box interior. Drawer cannot intersect door cavity. Plain rear mounting side. Duplicate this asset for left/right bed sides; do not create two different cabinets.

INT-SUITE-FURN-001-S03 — Wardrobe. W,D,H [1.6, 0.65, 2.4] m proposed. ONE freestanding two-door wardrobe, ivory carved timber and gold rose/star strips, shallow rose-marble plinth, indigo/blush inset door panels. Both doors closed in main view; small cutaway inset shows simple shelf and hanging rail. Keep door thickness, opening direction and rear enclosure clear. No gowns, loose hangers, flowers, giant crown or attached room architecture.

INT-SUITE-FURN-001-S04 — Dressing table. W,D,H [1.4, 0.5, 0.8] m proposed. ONE dressing table BASE only, rose-veined ivory marble top, fine gilded floral apron and four slender lotus-foot legs, one shallow central drawer. Open leg space and modest human scale. NO mirror, seat, cosmetics or chandelier; reuse the existing GEN-24 moon mirror separately. Flat back edge can sit against wall. Show underside support rails and actual flat rear.
